protocol: TH13 PC retail 1.00c, original human replay observation/action pairing

camera.source: stock game window rendered via PIL ImageGrab.grab(window=HWND)

clock.stability: native stage and stage tick and input word must agree on both sides of the actual pixel grab
clock.lattice: next native tick divisible by 4 where available; true observed ticks retained
clock.mode: only controllable play; excludes dialogue, ending and respawn; read gaps from native_frame

schema.action: int64 [N,4]: first next tick move, focus, shoot. Bomb is OR across upcoming four ticks.
schema.native_input: uint16 [N], observed physical replay word on screenshot tick
schema.input_chunk: uint16 [N,4], replay words at validated native index+1..+4
schema.past_input_chunk: uint16 [N,8], replay words at native index-7..0 inclusive. Last entry is the action already applied on camera tick.
schema.xy: float32 [N,2], native player center. Pixel center on output image approximately (48+x/4,y/4). Diagnostic only

grouping: Entire source player belongs to exactly one split. Held maps to existing upstream validation split. Use native_frame for contiguous windows; never bridge players or missing chunks.
quality: Measure native input agreement over decoded native index offsets [-60,+60] on moving controllable frames. Require ≥97% best-offset agreement, then keep only individually exact words. Separate audit also tests movement-vs-coordinate phase and original image correspondence.
design: Stage 1 first at several difficulties and shots, chosen before capture. Corpus is replay-selected and native stock game RNG is replay-fixed. Independent gameplay outcomes are reported by the online evaluation separately.
